Let’s break this down step by step.  

1. The expression is:  
   \( ( ( \text{not False} ) ) \ \text{and} \ \text{True} \)  

2. First, evaluate \( \text{not False} \):  
   \( \text{not False} = \text{True} \)  

3. Now substitute back:  
   \( \text{True} \ \text{and} \ \text{True} \)  

4. Evaluate \( \text{True} \ \text{and} \ \text{True} \):  
   This is \( \text{True} \).  

Final answer: true
